## Change boundary

- OpenSpec change ID (or `N/A` with reason):
- Canonical owner(s) from `docs/OWNERSHIP_MAP.md`:
- Consumer impact classification: internal / public-versioned / runtime-native / none
- Old path removed or replaced (no ungoverned dual path):

## Definition of Ready

- [ ] The approved proposal/spec and acceptance criteria cover this exact slice.
- [ ] Existing code, tests, migrations, and overlapping active changes were audited.
- [ ] Any public contract impact has an Owner decision recorded with the consumer-impact template.
- [ ] Security, credential, Runtime-distribution, and platform-tier implications are stated.

## Verification

- Exact source SHA reviewed:
- [ ] `bun run check:full`
- [ ] Targeted regression tests are recorded in the change's `verification.md`.
- [ ] Required manual or packaged smoke evidence is recorded, or an explicit blocker remains open.
- [ ] Codex implementation verdict and fresh-context Claude Code review refer to the same source SHA.
- [ ] No P0/P1 findings remain; accepted lower-severity findings are documented.

## Integration authority

- Owner acceptance:
- Authorized target branch:
- [ ] No remote push, PR mutation, merge, release, or ruleset change was performed without explicit Owner authorization.
- [ ] If an emergency bypass was used, its reason, source SHA, target, and accepted risk are recorded.

## Data and rollback

- Migration / reset / rollback behavior:
- User-data impact (test-only data may still be reset only when the approved change says so):
